verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a SaaS API-management platform like Konnect, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents Konnect region selection or residency controls. Hybrid and DB-less self-hosted deployment models are a related deployment feature, not a documented residency choice, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
